title: Projection normalization of the completed open limit mate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For schemes $X,Z$ let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ be a quasi-compact open immersion. Write $R_T$ for the completed integral coefficient ring on the small pro-etale site, $\mathcal L_T$ for the specified total right derived inverse limit on strict towers of $R_T$-modules, $\pi_{T,n}$ for its derived projection, $j_{!,R}$ for open extension and $j_{!,R}^{\rm Tow}$ for its termwise strict-tower functor, all as in [def-sp-complete-compactification-limit-comparison]. The specified constant-diagram mate $\lambda:\mathcal L_Xj_{!,R}\to j_{!,R}^{\rm Tow}\mathcal L_Z$ is invertible on the entire unbounded derived category. For every strict derived tower $K$ and $n\ge0$, $\lambda_K\,\pi_{Z,n}(j_{!,R}^{\rm Tow}K)=j_{!,R}(\pi_{X,n}(K))\,e_{j,n,K}^{-1}$, with $e$ the canonical exact evaluation/localization comparison fixedOpenEvaluation. No boundedness, constructibility or normalization is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the open pro-etale site with the slice and its actual ring module extension. Localized-system exactness gives exact open extension; its canonical countable-product map is invertible by the ringed open product theorem. Both sites have exact countable products. Apply the exact-product strict-limit theorem. Its signed Roos comparison is the canonical product comparison on both summands, and its augmentation normalization identifies it by const/limit transposition with openLimit. Its projection formula becomes the displayed equation after the standard exact evaluation localization factors. This holds also for the empty and identity open.

mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.ExactFunctor, exactFunctor_iff, Functor.exact_tfae. These ordinary exactness assertions do not give the strict derived limit comparison.
CategoryTheory.mateEquiv; mateEquiv_counit; unit_mateEquiv; mateEquiv_vcomp. General mate equations alone do not prove the specified mate invertible or normalize the derived projections.

Mathlib functor PointwiseRightDerived/PointwiseLeftDerived and Ext files. No exact-product strict-tower/Rlim comparison. Local cbcRealizationLimitMap_isIso gives only invertibility; exactProductFunctorStrictLimit is the retained general dependency.
